scope: Offline replay fidelity only; no survival, policy quality, win rate or highest-difficulty evidence.
selection: Run outcome was known before selection. This abandoned Emperor attempt is selected for its preserved exact decider snapshot and complete 394-frame history, not favorable performance.
protocol_evidence: Each of the 394 state segments has an await or orders_peek_wake before order execution. Initial state is before tiles and tiles_done. Replans generally have no tiles_done. Brain polls a live append-only file, not an explicit export-ready signal.

workload.baseline_and_candidate: Both use the same frozen original binary and all 282 original force flags.
workload.frame_subset: Every recorded turn/frame, including same-turn replans and empty orders; no exclusions or substitute run.

boundary_plan: Request once per state only after its first matching await or orders_peek_wake; include preceding terrain exports but reject an unclosed frame at a newer state, current-frame order execution receipt, cutoff or EOF. Record each request prefix hash and byte count. Do not read into future frame or current-frame action receipts to manufacture matches.
gate: All 394 baseline replies must exactly equal Native orders and complete decision; both arms must be identical with correct integer request identity, zero exits, unchanged input hashes. Any mismatch is a failed control, not proof of policy or game strength. No A/B until the full-history gate passes.
required_tests: no future frame/current action receipt leakage
EOF/cutoff/second state before boundary fail closed
existing exact-comparison, process-exit and immutable-input tests
not_changed: Native game, brain, orders database, runtime
